div.p: The courses most Coddy learners take.

span.span: Python, Linux, Git, SQL, data structures and algorithms, then code others can read.
Python and pygame, from a first window to a platformer.

div.p: Build websites and web apps, from the first tag to React.

span.span: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Next.js, then real projects.
The page, the server and the database: JavaScript, React, Next.js and SQL.

div.p: General-purpose languages for apps, scripts and backends.

span.span: Python, Linux, Git, SQL, data structures and algorithms, then code others can read.
Python, SQL, Linux, Git and Docker, before any framework.

div.p: Get close to the machine: memory, chips and smart contracts.

span.span: Ten data structures, eight sorts, recursion, DP, graphs, then interview practice.

div.p: Build apps for iPhone and Android.

span.span: Dart, Flutter and four complete phone apps.
Swift, SwiftUI and interview practice in Swift.

div.p: Make your own games in Roblox, Unity and Godot.

span.span: Roblox scripting and seven complete Roblox games.
C#, Unity scripting and ten 3D games.

div.p: Query, analyze and chart data, and put AI to work.

span.span: Excel, SQL, Python, NumPy and Pandas, in the order the job uses them.
Python, SQL, statistics and machine learning.

div.p: The command line and the tools every developer works with.

span.span: Linux, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL and Python, in the order the job needs them.
The OSI model, IP addressing and subnetting, real terminal tools and LAN labs.

div.p: From arithmetic to trigonometry, worked out step by step.
Physics from forces to gravity, solved step by step.
Chemistry from atoms to the periodic table, built on interactive benches.
From the rules to tactics, checkmates and endgames.
Security from the first alert to a contained breach.
See all courses or pick a course to start learning.

span.span: Reference documentation for every supported language.
Write and run code in the browser, no setup required.
Games made with code. Play them in your browser.
Free utilities for developers: formatters, converters, and more.
Add a free, runnable code editor to your own site with one iframe.
Quick-reference tables for the languages and tools you use.
Plain definitions of programming terms, each with a runnable example.
Coding interview problems you can run in the browser, with hints.
Questions with short answers, runnable code and output quizzes.
Every Git command you reach for, with syntax, flags, and examples.
Watch algorithms and data structures run step by step.
Free step-by-step calculators that show every line of working.
Every idea explained with something you can drag, plot or try.
Problems by topic with answers, and a problem of the day.
Factors, prime factorization and multiples, one page per number.
Every formula on one printable sheet, with a free PDF.
Free physics calculators that solve for any value and show every step.
Mechanics, electricity and waves formulas on printable sheets, with free PDFs.
All 118 elements by family, block and trend. Tap one for its details.
Six bots from beginner to master, plus pass-and-play. Free, with a coaching review.
Interactive boards and references you can try in place.
Every rule and tactic explained on a board you play it on.
Every opening on a board you play: the main line, the plans, the traps.
A daily puzzle and mate in 1, 2 and 3 sets.
Standalone incident cases to solve at your own pace.
Learn what Coddy is and the team behind it.
Tutorials, guides, and stories from the Coddy team.
Reads your code and your error, explains, and hints. Never the answer.
Earn shareable certificates by completing courses.
Get in touch with support, partnerships, or press.
Quick facts, founder bios, and the press contact.
Logo, colors, fonts, voice, and our characters Bit and Bugsy.
Open roles, our mission, and what it’s like to work at Coddy.
Coddy for teachers: assign lessons, track progress, and grade automatically.
Promote Coddy and earn commissions on referrals.
Learn to code on iPhone and Android, free on both stores.
Build full-stack apps with AI: chat, preview, and publish.

div.p: Arrow keys or WASD to move - Space to start
